title: Quitting music around 1929
summary: Moore explains giving up playing at the Bismarck hotel because of the Depression, the union fee dispute and the shift to reading band music.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band
